name: Annex III standard-deployer screener
description: General-purpose Annex III screening questionnaire covering all eight high-risk categories plus Article 6(3) derogation criteria. Domain-specific templates (hr-tech, fintech) extend a subset of these questions.

questions.label: Does the system perform remote biometric identification of natural persons?
Is its sole purpose biometric verification (1:1 match) of a person's identity?
Does the system categorise natural persons by sensitive or protected attributes (race, opinions, sexual orientation, etc.)?
Does the system infer emotions or affective states of natural persons?
Is the system a safety component in the management or operation of critical infrastructure?
Which critical infrastructure domain?

sections.title: Annex III(3) — Education and vocational training

questions.label: Does the system determine access, admission or assignment to education or vocational training?
Does the system evaluate learning outcomes (including to steer the learning process)?
Does the system assess the appropriate level of education a person should receive?
Does the system monitor and detect prohibited behaviour during tests?
Is the system used for recruitment or selection (advertising, filtering, evaluating candidates)?
Does it influence promotion, termination, or task allocation in work-related relationships?
Does it monitor and evaluate performance or behaviour of workers?
Does the system determine eligibility for public assistance benefits, services, or healthcare?
Is it used to evaluate creditworthiness or establish credit scores?
Is its sole purpose detecting financial fraud (excluded from Annex III(5)(b))?
Is it used for risk assessment or pricing of life or health insurance?
Does it dispatch or prioritise dispatch of emergency first-response services?
Used to assess risk of a person becoming a victim of a criminal offence?
Is it a polygraph or similar tool used by law enforcement?
Used to evaluate the reliability of evidence in a criminal investigation?
Used to assess offending or re-offending risk, or personality traits?
Used to profile natural persons during detection, investigation, or prosecution?

sections.title: Annex III(7) — Migration, asylum, border control

questions.label: Is it a polygraph or similar tool used in migration / border control?
Used to assess security, irregular-migration, or health risks of persons crossing borders?
Used to examine asylum, visa, or residence permit applications and complaints?
Used to detect or identify persons in migration / border-control contexts?

sections.title: Annex III(8) — Justice and democratic processes

questions.label: Does the system assist a judicial authority (or ADR) in interpreting and applying the law?
Is it used to influence election or referendum outcomes or voting behaviour?
Are voters NOT directly exposed to the system's output (campaign back-office only)?

sections.title: Article 6(3) — Derogation criteria
sections.rationale: Even when an Annex III match exists, a system is not high-risk where it does not pose significant risk to health, safety, or fundamental rights. Profiling carve-out applies regardless.

questions.label: Does the system perform only a narrow procedural task?
Does it only improve the result of a previously completed human activity?
Does it detect decision-making patterns or deviations from such patterns (and not replace human judgment)?
If pattern-detection: is the system's output subject to proper human review before action?
Does it perform only a preparatory task to a human assessment?
Does the system perform profiling of natural persons (carve-out — disables the derogation)?
Is the AI system a safety component of (or itself) a product covered by Annex I harmonisation legislation?
Which Annex I instrument applies?
Does the underlying product require third-party conformity assessment under that legislation?
